senses.gloss:
pṛ́śni, a. speckled; dapple, esp. of kine;
as f. Priśni, mother of the Maruts. [cf.
περκνός, ‘dark colored’; Old High Ger.
forhana, whence Ger. Forelle, ‘trout.’]

pṛṣad-ājyá, n. speckled butter, ghee
clotted with curds. [pṛ́ṣant.]

pṛṣṭhá, n.
 —1. back, of an animal;
 —2.
the upper side, surface;
 —3. top, of a hill
or palace. [cf. Ger. First, ‘ridge of a
house’; AS. first-hrōf, ‘ridge-pole’: observe
that νῶτος has mgs 1, 2, and 3, that
Lat. tergum has mgs 1 and 2, and that
Eng. ridge has mgs 1 and 3.]

pṛṣṭha-māṃsa, n. back-flesh; w. khād,
in double sense, bite the back-flesh and
back-bite.
